model.name: GingerO1
model.validation: experimental; field spread-rate benchmark only, no operational arrival or ignition validation

source.attribution: Gould, Jim; Gomes Da Cruz, Miguel; & Sullivan, Andrew (2023): 1986 Annaburroo Experimental Grassland Fire Data. v3. CSIRO. Data Collection. https://doi.org/10.25919/ycd3-w209

protocol: chronological burn-day train/validation/test split; one training-fitted scale candidate selected on validation; test is not used for candidate fitting or selection. Leave-one-day-out diagnostics are secondary and are not used to revise the candidate.

excluded.reason: Missing/invalid midflame wind, measured moisture, observed ROS, or unique burn day

assumptions: Anderson fuel 1 grass proxy, as in the live engine; flat terrain.
Published derived midflame wind is supplied directly in km/h; no additional 10 m wind adjustment.
Measured dead-fuel moisture with the live engine minimum of 1%; live moisture held at 90% (fuel 1 has no live fuel load).
Primary target: observed plot-average ROS × 60, m/min. Derived steady-state RSS is not a target or input.
Fuel load, height, treatment, curing and ignition-line effects are not resolved by the current fixed grass proxy.
These retrospective measured inputs are not archived operational forecasts.
Australian experimental grass fires do not validate Catalan forest, urban ignition, grid perimeters, or building arrivals.

calibration.reason: Single-site grass-only calibration remains a research artifact; no geographic transfer validation.
